check:        aioverview: digest dominance coherent with home (<=1%)
previously matched: 'dominance ... <n>'   (anchor: dominance[^0-9]{0,40}(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?))

Why the anchor is a pattern and not a literal phrase
----------------------------------------------------
The digest is upstream's own prose ("their words", labelled as theirs). The
connective between the word "dominance" and the figure rotates with the
template, so the harness anchors on the noun and tolerates any 0-40 non-digit
run after it, rather than grepping one fixed phrase. Every observed form
matches the first anchor; two fallbacks cover the shapes that moved the figure
behind another word or a percent sign.

  source: tests/fixtures/aioverview.json.gz
          (sha256 6dd93dae26c72c53579323acea87b017e85032d4d619832db593f0b8f3bb7b84)
          upstream https://cryptorank.io/ai-market-overview  (cr_fetch.py --path /ai-market-overview)
  sentence: "... Bitcoin dominance slipped to 56.645237 (down 0.42%), while Ethereum's share rose to 11.06 ..."
  anchor match: 'dominance slipped to 56.645237'

Live capture 2026-10-05
  source: GET http://127.0.0.1:3101/api/cryptorank?mode=aioverview
  sentence: "... Bitcoin dominance eased to 57.19% and Ethereum's to 11.02%, ..."
  anchor match: 'dominance eased to 57.19'

Other observed forms the same anchor already covers
  'dominance stands at <n>'      -> non-digit run " stands at " (11 chars) < 40
  'dominance is at <n>%'         -> non-digit run " is at " (7 chars) < 40
  'Bitcoin maintains a dominant <n> share ...'
                                 -> fallback anchor: dominant\s+(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*share
  'BTC dominance ... <n>%'       -> fallback anchor: BTC dominance[^%\n]{0,80}?(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)\s*%

Contracted 2026-09-29 rotation (documented in the harness block)
  old form:  'dominance ... <n>'        (first digit within 40 chars of the noun)
  rotated:   'dominance are essentially flat ... Bitcoin maintains a dominant 56.73955 share'
             (first digit sat 44 chars after 'dominance'; the value moved behind 'dominant ... share')

Rule that holds here: the fix is the MEASUREMENT, never a widened tolerance.
Only when the prose yields a number is the unchanged <=1% coherence bound
asserted; a rotation that yields none is reported as INFO, never failed.
